services.name: Tiki Boat Cruise
services.desc: You can't drink and drive a boat any more than you can a car. But that doesn't mean you can't have a blast on the water. Let Atlantic City Tiki Boat do the driving for you so you can raise your glass while you cruise. With a full service bar onboard, NJ liquor license and professional bartender, all of the drinks will be available for you, no BYOB necessary or permitted. Our Atlantic City Tiki Boat has room for up to 25 passengers and is US Coast Guard certified for your peace of mind. Whether you want to book a party for friends and family or just want to join a fun cruise, we'll make sure you leave with great memories. Learn more about our cruise in Atlantic City, NJ by contacting us
